metadata.title: Minimalist Studio Portrait with Surreal Prop

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a man in a dark suit standing in a minimalist, cornered studio space. To his right, a white ironing board holds a melting or distorted electric guitar. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a long, soft-edged shadow on the left wall, while the background features a mottled, painterly texture in muted blue and beige tones.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's vertical posture balances the horizontal line of the ironing board.
The dark suit provides a high-contrast anchor against the pale, textured walls.
The distorted guitar acts as a surreal focal point that breaks the formal realism of the portrait.
coreInvariants: Soft, elongated shadow on the left vertical plane
Ironing board with a white lace-trimmed cloth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man is positioned in the left third of the frame, full-body scale; the ironing board occupies the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's dark suit and bearded face serve as the primary anchor, while the guitar provides the secondary conceptual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the man's face, moves down his suit to the ironing board, and follows the guitar neck toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper right and center creates a sense of airiness and highlights the wall texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm wood tones and white (guitar and ironing board)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist name and title, distinguished by spacing or slight weight variation.
graphicDevices: Minimalist alignment to the top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean 80s aesthetic and uniform stroke weight.
Provides a similar clean, uppercase presence with classic proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a man in a dark suit and tie standing in a corner. The walls are a mottled, textured mix of pale blue and beige. To the right is a white ironing board with a lace cloth, holding a surreal, melting electric guitar. A soft, long shadow is cast on the left wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name and title in the top right corner using a bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif font with wide tracking in black.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar visibly distorted or 'melting'?
Is the wall texture painterly and mottled?
Is the text positioned in the top right with wide spacing?
Is there a soft, vertical shadow on the left wall?

adjustableVariables: Length and softness of the shadow
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos on the guitar
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ironing board looks like a domestic object.
Check that the shadow matches the light source direction.
Verify the text is clean and legible against the mottled background.
Confirm the man's suit is a deep, solid dark tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a formal, dark-suited subject with a mundane domestic object that has been surrealistically altered, set against a highly textured, desaturated studio backdrop with geometric sans-serif typography placed in the negative space.
